title: New Bitcoin upgrade catches hidden key leaks hiding the exact fix
summary:
BIP461 would make compliant ECDSA signatures reproducible, enabling comparisons that flag deviations without proving malicious firmware.
The post New Bitcoin upgrade catches hidden key leaks hiding the exact fix appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: A proposed Bitcoin upgrade known as BIP461 aims to detect hidden key leaks by making ECDSA signatures reproducible. This update allows for easy comparisons that can flag deviations in firmware without requiring proof of malicious intent. The enhancement provides a new layer of security and transparency for users navigating potential vulnerabilities in the network.
